items.source: By default, this converter supports the MediaType.APPLICATION_YAML_VALUE media type. This can be overridden by setting the supportedMediaTypes property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此转换器支持MediaType.APPLICATION_YAML_VALUE媒体类型。可以通过设置supportedMediaTypes属性来覆盖此默认值。

items.source: Construct a new instance with a YAMLMapper customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader).
items.translation: 使用 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 找到的 `JacksonModule` 自定义的 `YAMLMapper` 构造一个新实例。

items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided YAMLMapper.Builder customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader).
items.translation: 使用 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 找到的 `JacksonModule` 对提供的 `YAMLMapper.Builder` 进行自定义，并构建一个新实例。

items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided YAMLMapper.
items.translation: 使用提供的YAMLMapper构建一个新实例。

items.source: The following hints entries are supported:
A JSON view with a "com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonView" key and the class name of the JSON view as value.
items.translation: 带有 `"com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonView"` 键以及 JSON 视图类名作为值的 JSON 视图。

items.source: A filter provider with a "tools.jackson.databind.ser.FilterProvider" key and the filter provider class name as value.
items.translation: 具有"tools.jackson.databind.ser.FilterProvider"键以及过滤器提供程序类名作为值的过滤器提供程序。
